lead_description: Procurement officer asked us to register on their vendor portal, with no information about an actual requirement yet.
Someone from a competitor asked for a demo to study our features.
School administrator is interested but needs to wait for the new academic year budget.
Person asked if the product can be used to automate their home chores.
Startup founder is ready to sign the annual enterprise plan today and asked for an invoice.
Retired person curious about the technology after reading an article; no business need.
Owner of a 40-store pharmacy chain asked for contract papers after a successful pilot and wants to start next Monday.
Engineering manager is testing our tool alongside a competitor and will share feedback in a month.
Person asked for a free consultation about a legal issue unrelated to our services.
CTO of a 500-employee firm wants to buy 200 licenses this quarter, budget of $80k approved.
Procurement head needs a vendor onboarded within 2 weeks; contract signing planned for Friday.
Small shop owner said they only want the cheapest free tool and will not pay anything.
Person asked for a demo just to see what it looks like and said they have no project right now.
Individual asked for a discount code to use on a personal blog.
Student asking about the product for a college assignment.
Clinic chain owner wants to roll out in 8 branches next month and asked for a bulk discount to finalize.
Intern collecting information for a competitor analysis report, with no purchase authority.
COO requested an on-site demo for the leadership team and said a decision will be made this week.
Manager needs approval from finance before proceeding but is interested in a trial.
Visitor wrote in a language we do not support and gave no business context.
Startup CTO asked for a technical call but said the decision lies with the CEO who is travelling.
Procurement analyst asked for a detailed proposal document for internal discussion, with no confirmed deadline.
Team lead attended our webinar and asked for a case study; budget not confirmed.
Person asked whether the service is cheaper than a free open-source alternative and said they will not pay.
Researcher wants free data for an academic paper and has no intent to purchase.
Person is just curious how the tool works and has no plans to buy.
Franchise owner is interested in a multi-location plan but first wants to see how other franchises use it.
Journalist asked for a quote about industry trends and has no interest in the product.
Prospect submitted the form three times with random characters.
Mid-size retailer attended our event, collected a demo link, and plans to revisit it after the holidays.
Freelance writer asked if we can sponsor a newsletter for free.
Hospital group requested a demo and pricing; funds sanctioned and go-live targeted next month.
Spam message promoting unrelated products with a link in the description.
Subscribed to the newsletter but never opened any email or visited the pricing page.
Visitor asked what time the office opens and had no interest in the product.
Company located in a region we do not serve asked a general question and has no plan to expand.
University registrar has an approved tender and needs our proposal submitted by Thursday.
Product manager at a mid-size SaaS company asked for API documentation and a sandbox account but has not mentioned a purchase plan.
Company is happy with the free trial but says the decision involves several other stakeholders.
Hotel group manager requested a quotation to compare with two other vendors and expects to decide sometime next half-year.
Freelancer asked if we offer a pay-per-use plan at a few cents per month.
Customer success head asked about enterprise features but is currently under contract with another vendor until next year.
Business owner requested a callback next month because they are currently busy with a store renovation.
Retail manager liked the product demo but said the head office must approve any new software spending.
Small business owner is interested in the product but will decide after the next quarter.
Sales manager downloaded two whitepapers and asked a technical question about integrations.
Finance analyst asked for an ROI calculator to build an internal business case.
User asked how to cancel a subscription of a different company by mistake.
Product owner wants a proof of concept, though the purchase authority sits with another team.
Individual asked if we can build a free website for their family business.
Visitor said they might consider the tool in two or three years and want nothing right now.
Telecom procurement team shortlisted us as the final vendor and requested a negotiation call this week with budget approval attached.
Freelancer wants a free version only and has zero budget.
A person searched for a competitor's name and landed on our page by mistake.
Visitor requested a free sample report for a school presentation.
Healthcare administrator asked about compliance certifications and mentioned a possible purchase later this year.
Contact from an unrelated industry asked if we buy used office furniture.
Small hobbyist wants to know if there is a lifetime free plan.
Insurance firm's CIO needs the platform live before the regulatory deadline in three weeks and has secured funding.
Prospect said they are only collecting quotes for a hypothetical project that may never happen.
Consultant is evaluating tools on behalf of a client and has not shared budget or timeline.
Marketing manager is comparing three tools and wants a pricing sheet; no timeline given.
Visitor filled the contact form with a fake name and an irrelevant message.
Visitor asked for a free trial extension for an account that was never created.
Airline operations head must replace the current scheduling tool by month end and has board sign-off.
Operations lead asked for a feature comparison against two competitors, with no decision date set.
College professor wants free access for classroom teaching and has no purchasing role.
Individual asked whether the product works on a very old phone, with no business need described.
Local club asked for free tickets to our conference.
Job seeker wrote asking whether the company is hiring.
Company requested a brochure and said they may schedule a demo later.
Government department issued an RFP with confirmed funding and a 30-day decision deadline.
IT analyst is exploring options to replace the current CRM within the next 6 to 9 months.
IT manager asked whether we support single sign-on and said they are shortlisting vendors for next year's plan.
Operations manager requested references from similar companies and said the evaluation will take a while.
User sent a single question mark through the contact form.
A recruiter asked to share candidate profiles through the inquiry form.
Training institute asked about volume discounts but said the budget has not been finalised.
Procurement manager sent a purchase order and is waiting only for our onboarding date.
Customer from another company asked for technical support on a product we do not sell.
Agency owner is interested in a partnership but wants to understand pricing tiers first.
Existing customer wants to triple their licenses immediately because their team is growing fast.
Logistics supervisor asked about integration with their existing ERP and said the IT team must review it first.
Retail chain wants a pilot in 10 stores starting next week; purchase order attached.
Visitor asked for a refund on an item purchased from another store.
Student working on a thesis asked for a one-hour interview with our founder.
Newsletter subscriber replied that they have no need for the service and asked us to stop writing.
Someone asked how to unsubscribe from our emails.
Operations head at a regional bank asked for a presentation and said the project may start next financial year.
Unknown sender pasted a link to a crypto giveaway in the message.
A user asked for a free logo design after reading our blog.
Teenager asked if the tool can help with a gaming channel.
Marketing director signed up for the webinar series and downloaded the pricing guide twice.
Startup founder likes the product but is waiting for the next funding round before buying.
Bank's digital head asked for security documentation to close the deal and has a signed budget sheet.
Nonprofit program director is interested but is waiting for a grant decision before committing funds.
Individual asked for help writing their resume.
Someone clicked an ad accidentally and left no contact details beyond an email address.
Data analyst requested a trial for the team and will present the results to management next quarter.
Student requested a free internship opportunity through the sales inquiry form.
Department head requested pricing for planning purposes and will review options in a few months.
Logistics company needs to replace its failing system immediately and has allocated funds for this quarter.
Student club requested a donation and free software for their event.
Vendor trying to sell us their own services through the inquiry form.
Manufacturing plant manager must deploy before the audit next month; payment terms already agreed.
VP of Operations urgently needs an automation tool before year end and has CEO approval.
HR head wants to see a demo but said the budget cycle only opens in January.
Construction firm director wants to purchase 100 licenses immediately and asked for bank details to transfer the advance.
Director of IT asked for a final quote and legal terms; board approved the purchase yesterday.
Real estate agency owner watched the demo video and asked for pricing for 5 users, with no urgency stated.

E-commerce owner is migrating from a competitor, has signed their cancellation, and wants to start this week.
Co-founder is interested but wants to wait until the company hires its first sales team before buying.
Anonymous contact asked for our entire customer list.

CFO confirmed a 150k budget and wants to onboard our platform before the end of this month.
Education consultant is exploring tools for a client school and will report back after the vacations.
Blogger asked for a free license in exchange for a mention, with no business use.
Founder of a funded startup needs the product live before their launch in two weeks and has the budget ready.
